First impression after reading the code: `virtual` is an unnecessary cost on this new implementation. It's prone to the callee code being thrown out of the branch predictor, and the code cache, since it's not known at compile time which branch will be called.[^1] This cost should be especially present if other code is called in between calling this code (which I believe isn't accounted for in your cold tests, since you just churn memory instead of code). We should only try to abstract when it's actually useful to reduce complexity in the code. If making it composeable is impossible, or CRTP turns out too complicated, it might be preferable to simply duplicate the hash table code for `AHashSet`.
